Every booth in a bundle runs for 4 hours. The GH₵1,000 print upgrade is available for the Selfie, Magazine and Magic Mirror booths: one print per session, up to 100 prints per event. Transportation cost depends on your event location.

How booking works

  1. Pick your booths

    Choose a single booth or one of the festive bundles, then tell us your date and venue.

  2. Secure your date

    A 50% payment holds your event date for you.

  3. Pay the balance

    The remaining balance is due at least one week before your event.

  4. We arrive early

    Our team arrives two hours before your start time and is ready when your guests are.

Terms and conditions

Booking and payment

A 50% payment secures your event date. The balance is due at least one week before the event.

Free cancellation

Cancel at least two weeks before your event date at no charge. Later cancellations forfeit the booking payment.

Setup time

Our team arrives two hours before the agreed start time to set up, and is fully ready by the start time.

Space and power

We need an 8 x 8 ft space and a working power outlet to operate our booths.

Coverage

Packages run for 4 hours from the agreed start time. Setup and breakdown are included.

Extra hours

Additional hours are available on request, subject to availability and an extra charge.

Equipment care

Guests are asked to handle equipment with care. Damage caused by guests is the client's responsibility.

Transportation

Transportation cost depends on the event location and is confirmed when you book.

Lock in your date

Tell us what you need and your message goes straight to us on WhatsApp. We will confirm availability and send your booking details.
